_note: The first-time tour Chelo gives. A step with 'building' pans the city to it and shows that building's about / do / cost from buildings.json. A step with 'hud' points at part of the screen.

steps.title: Welcome to Atlantis
steps.chelo: Before the tide turns, let me show you around. It won't take long.
lines: Atlantis sinks at the end of the year. The last ship out sells Passage for coin, and only to people who owe nothing.
You have four seasons: Spring, Summer, Autumn and the Long Dark. Each one gives you six tides. A tide is one move.
Working, a Market trip and an Exchange visit spend tides. Walking, talking and banking are free.

steps.title: Your season and tides
steps.chelo: Keep an eye on this. Tides run out faster than you'd think.
lines: This shows the season and how many tides you have left.
When they run out the season ends, and you get a report on how it went.

steps.chelo: Most of your coin starts here. Six tides a season, so spend them on purpose.
Your household eats every season, whatever else you do. Plan for it.
Ione's desk. Nothing here costs a tide, so come as often as you like.
This is where you'll buy your way out. It's also where coin can grow, or sink.
Good for gossip, and Nerissa's games are fun. Just remember who wins in the end.
Grin always says yes. That's the trouble with Grin.
Old Maro's neighbours look after each other. Keep your promises to them.
When the Council speaks, prices move. Listen to the Herald.

steps.title: Passage on the last ship
steps.chelo: That number only goes up. Waiting is a choice too.
lines: This is your goal: what Passage costs this season, and how close you are.
It rises every season. Coin that just sits there falls behind.

steps.title: Off you go
steps.chelo: I'll find you at the end of each season with a report on how you did.
lines: Click any building to walk there and go in. Click the ground to walk, drag to look around, scroll to zoom.
Not sure where to start? The Guild Hall pays, and the Market feeds you.
Every room has a Modern Mirror that shows what it's like in the real world. Press Guide at the top to see this tour again.
